title: Enterprise legal risk heatmap + autosuggest clause templates for MSA/DPA negotiations
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Goal: Reduce cycle time on enterprise MSA/DPA negotiations and surface pricing/indemnity impacts by generating a risk heatmap for incoming redlines and providing autosuggest clause templates with rationale and pricing delta estimates. Deliverables: 1) a classifier that tags clause redlines (indemnity, liability cap, escrow, audit rights, data residency, IP), 2) a UI heatmap in the Sales Legal intake that shows risk score + suggested counter-clause, 3) heuristic pricing / SLA adjustment guidance tied to each risk band, and 4) a playbook snippet to auto-fill negotiation responses for common redlines to speed counter-proposal generation.
acceptance_criteria: Classifier tags >80% of clause redlines into defined categories on a 500-sample QA set
Heatmap UI mock implemented in Console intake that displays risk band (low/medium/high) per clause and overall contract
Autosuggest templates available in intake with at least 5 variant templates per clause category and legal rationale notes
Pricing delta guidance (ballpark multipliers) surfaced for >70% of high-risk clauses and validated with Sales ops
Hand-off doc and 1-hour training session for Legal and Sales with measurable reduction in first-response time by 30% in pilot
risks: Legal pushback on automated language — must remain advisory not prescriptive
False positives on classifier could misrepresent risk leading to wrong pricing decisions
Integration latency with intake UI could slow sales workflows if not optimized
Edge-case clauses (customer-provided) will require manual triage and override paths

final_note: This ticket ties directly to reducing time-to-close for enterprise deals while making indemnity/liability trade-offs explicit for Sales. Keep the experience advisory; Legal retains final sign-off. Aim for measurable pilot outcomes before automating any language insertion into counters.
